incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV1 ALERT 13:07 UTC — spike in 500s for /embeddings across eu-west-1 and fallback churn to chat runtimes. tag=routing.policy.alias_lock

maya_oncall: I'm paged. seeing a big errors spike on Embeddings service, stderr shows transform failures expecting embeddings array. pinging infra and policy owners.

nikhil_sre: grabbing routing history. There was an automated alias promotion at 13:01 UTC that bound alias 'enterprise-embed' to model rv-chat-20b@canary as part of a multi-tenant rollout. That alias was supposed to be embed-only. Looks like the control-plane allowed cross-family binding.

luke_infra: Confirming runtime logs — lots of fallback churn. Router tried to route embed calls to chat variant, runtime returned messages object, transform -> 500, then router retried -> hit regional fallback -> routed to other region chat runtime -> same error -> increased latency and retries. sample from router: 
```
[13:06:12] req=rx9 alias=enterprise-embed route=/embeddings/semantic -> model=rv-chat-20b@canary runtime=chat-rt-3 payload_type=chat
[13:06:12] transform:error req=rx9 err="schema_mismatch: expected embeddings, got messages"
[13:06:12] retry=1 -> routed to eu-central-1 chat-rt-5
[13:06:13] downstream:status=500 req=rx9
```

rachel_support: We're getting CS tickets and a Slack thread from the account team. Two paying customers in EU, batch embedding jobs failing intermittently. They report ~25% failure with some backoff retries failing entirely.

maya_oncall: Immediate plan: 1) freeze alias promotions 2) create an emergency route override in eu-west-1 to a known embed-capable model rv-embed-4b@stable 3) roll back the new alias promotion. Nikhil, can you freeze promotions? Luke, can you apply override?

nikhil_sre: Running control-plane command: 
```
control-plane freeze-alias-promotions --reason "emergency: alias cross-family binding causing embed failures"
```
freeze confirmed.

deploy-bot: Action by nikhil_sre: control-plane/freeze-alias-promotions -> SUCCESS.

luke_infra: Creating region override: 
```
redwoodctl route override create --region eu-west-1 --route "/embeddings/semantic" --target rv-embed-4b@stable --weight 100 --ttl 15m --note "emergency embed override"
```
override applied, traffic shifted ~98% in 45s.

maya_oncall: Rolling back the alias binding now. Which rollback id? Nikhil?

nikhil_sre: rollback command: 
```
control-plane alias unbind enterprise-embed rv-chat-20b@canary --requester=nikhil_sre
```
rollback success reported.

deploy-bot: control-plane alias unbind by nikhil_sre -> SUCCESS. rollback_id=rb-2026-03-15-1309

rachel_support: Customer update drafted and sent: "We've applied a temporary routing override and halted the rollout. We're monitoring and will provide a full RCA."

luke_infra: After override, error rate in eu-west-1 dropped from ~24% -> 3% in 4 minutes. Retries down, latency normalized.

sara_prod: Good catch. We need a guard in the policy engine that validates alias->model capability intersection before commit. Also add an alert when alias binds to a variant with zero overlap with any route families.

nikhil_sre: Implementing capability guard now. Patch: on alias-bind, resolve model.capabilities and route.required_capabilities, reject if intersection empty. rolling to control-plane nodes.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by nikhil_sre: policy/alias-capability-check v2.0 -> rollout=rolling global -> status=IN_PROGRESS.

incident-bot: NOTE: running canary checks for policy change across one control-plane region.

nikhil_sre: policy guard rolled out to control-plane eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Status=SUCCESS.

luke_infra: router logs now show bind rejection lines for same alias attempt (simulated): 
```
[13:15:42] bind_attempt alias=enterprise-embed target=rv-chat-20b@canary capabilities=[chat,instruct] route_req=[embeddings] -> REJECT reason=capability_intersection_empty
```

maya_oncall: Follow-up actions for postmortem: 1) add unit + integration tests for policy engine 2) add dashboard metric for cross-family binds and alias promotions 3) require canary for alias promotions that change capability set 4) run a scheduled audit of active aliases. Sara, can you own the dashboard?

sara_prod: I will. Also propose an automated dry-run that queries runtime metadata before allowing alias bind. I'll write a spec.

rachel_support: I want to capture customer impact: two customers affected, window ~13:01-13:16 UTC, estimated affected requests ~12k calls, peak failure rate 25%. Emails sent.

nikhil_sre: Marking incident mitigated at 13:18 UTC after override and policy guard. Leaving override active for 15m TTL then will remove once control-plane validations pass.

deploy-bot: override TTL expired and override removed automatically at 13:34 UTC. removal status=SUCCESS.

maya_oncall: Monitoring for 30m then will hand off to next oncall for postmortem writeup. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigated at 13:18 UTC -> severity lowered to SEV2. Postmortem owner assigned: sara_prod.
